record.name: Squarespace
record.one_liner: An ecommerce and website building platform providing APIs for managing orders, inventory, products, and more.
record.access_note: API access requires a Squarespace account on a paid plan (such as Commerce Advanced or Business depending on the API).
record.api_note: Covers commerce operations including orders, products, inventory, transactions, and contacts.

evidence.quote: authenticate requests by using an API key or OAuth access token.
With Squarespace's Commerce Advanced plan, you can develop a custom application for a Squarespace merchant site.
All Commerce APIs are built on HTTPS and designed with REST principles in mind.
Overview of the Squarespace MCP Server
Everything you need to build and publish external apps — reliable APIs, clear documentation
